doc.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29

chapter: Social life of old New Orleans
title: Storyville district: barrel houses, boundaries and respect
summary: Jim says the district ran him out as a boy, names its boundaries, and the men recall its people as decent.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Those barrel houses, they wouldn't roll you in any of those places? In the barrel houses?

Well, maybe your barrel houses, the district, I mean, you had that. I can't tell you so much about the district, they run me out of there. I won't be in there, like you said. I was a youngster then, man. I'm happy to get in that section, you understand? But the man wouldn't let me in there. He'd run me out of there.

But Dick, I'll tell you this. I was a young man. After I got to go over there, get that good, you understand? And learn the score, but they wouldn't worry. As long as you would do us right. But see, the boys, the thing, young men wasn't bad like this, bad now. Well, you see, them people would respect the certain sections.
They weren't bad. They weren't bad. They weren't bad. Like you call the spoken woman, you know what I mean?
In other words, you see, like you're a young man, and you go over there, and people take care of you, you understand? They still like you to take care of you.

Gasket Street? I mean, all around it, for sure. You see, the district boundary was, let's see. Between, you can only, you know. What's it? They say, Iberville Street down Basin Street to St. Louis, and the boundary of Robinson. That's really hearted the district. Hearted the district. Now, them people couldn't live in the other neighborhood, the Spoltan woman's, because the day after they broke the district, let people scatter all over the city, all over the town. You see, otherwise, you know. But don't let nobody fool you. I was around 17, getting around 60, 70 and old. At that time, I was driving trucks for nose off, 10, 17 canals.
But don't fool you. I tried to get around the district, but the police knew you'd be young, you understand? And they chased me out of their neighbor.
But see this. There's one thing.
Man, I'd be hiding around that section.

Them people aren't no bad people either, understand? Oh, no, no, no, no. They were to theirself. When they go to the market in the morning, and the women, you couldn't tell them who they was. And that's right. We dressed up pretty. Oh, but pretty dress on this. I'd be standing at the bridge, looking at them. Just give me that 50 cents to bring them baskets. More or less, I'd make them say for two dollars and say, thank you, Jesus.
